items.text: German: the group filter entry reads 'Alle Gruppen' instead of 'Alle Konstellationen'
Server names follow the game's region digit (NA East, NA West, Europe, LATAM, Asia) and the website shows them in the reader's language as the game spells them
Legions: a list of every legion per server and a page with its known members; the legion on a player profile links to it
Legion page: gear score (average item level) and combat power per member; the client sends the combat power of inspected players, stored in a new profile column
the first-start wizard is a single small window in the look of the Settings (language, privacy text and the three upload switches together)
Start page: preload the hero picture (LCP) and lighten the muted text colour on dark so the stat labels reach contrast 4.5:1
Footer wordmark gets width/height so the image reserves its space
Site strings are loaded per language (locales/<code>.js) instead of one 213 KB i18n.js with all eight; a visitor downloads his own language plus English as the fallback
Boss banners are 1920 px wide instead of 2400 (the page never shows more than about 1860 px)
Statistics page with the player, boss fight and download totals; the download button now counts its clicks
Statistics: conquest bosses show their star rating in the most-fought list
Statistics: the per-day lists start with the newest day

Aion 2 server names come from the game's own text for all 22 servers per faction (1301-1322 / 2301-2322); the backend turns an unnamed 'aion-2-server-<id>' upload into the named server, so it exists only once
Uploads carry the own server id and the game server address (IP:port); server names for every id of the game's own table (only block 13/23 counts as Europe, other blocks show as 'Name [id]')
The own character profile is no longer uploaded automatically by default (opt-in in the settings); privacy and download texts in all languages and the READMEs say so

First-start wizard (language and the upload options, all off by default) for a fresh install or a lost settings file; new setting to also upload the profiles of other players (off by default); without it only the own character is sent

first-start wizard that every install sees once after the update (language and the upload options, all off by default: boss upload, own profile, profiles of other players); until it is done nothing is uploaded; new setting to upload the profiles of other players; the server of an upload is named from the game's own table for every server id

the enchant level of an equipped item is read from its fixed place in the entry instead of the first non-zero byte, so Vakron Guard +10 (was +1), the second Clash Rune +4 (was +0) and other items with a flag byte are right

a character switch (twink) clears the previous character's skills, gear, Daevanion and species so they no longer end up in the other profile; the character name is detected automatically, the Settings field is gone
shield skills are recognised by skill id, so the German names (Schutzformation, Hoheit der Blockade, Schockaufhebung, Behütungsschild) work too; Impeding Authority counts as a group shield

group shield is Protection Circle (Chanter/Templar) with the caster as the event's target and the shielded player as its source; the upload credits it to the caster, personal shields (Defiance, Warding Shield) are only kept out of healing
Start page top players: no class-coloured row background, only tinted emblem and coloured bar
Player page runs tab: the boss name opens the run, not the boss overview

shields (Defiance, Warding Shield) are no longer counted as the recipient's healing; the caster is worked out from the skill's class and the group's shields are uploaded as shieldsGiven (shown on the run page's protection panel)

the automatic boss upload no longer postpones itself forever (its 4 s wait was restarted on every poll tick while a boss was queued); a small auto-upload.log in the settings folder records what it decided
Uploads: accept characters with 25+ equipment pieces, slots above 40 and more than 150 skills (about 40 % of profile uploads were rejected); log which field failed
automatic boss upload also fires for bosses that never send a hit-point reading (20 s after the last hit of a fight of at least 10 s) and for a boss whose last reading stopped within 0.5 % of zero
Start page: Nightmare runs show their step as a pill (Albtraum 5) next to the boss name
Link preview for fights: only damage per player in large type, readable at Discord's 400 px width; JPEG copies of the WebP art for the renderer
Fight page: hero picture falls back to the instance photo like the boss page does
damage a player does to themselves (Infiltrate, health costs) no longer counts as damage dealt or taken in the all-targets view
filter row starts flush left and every dropdown is only as wide as it needs to be
the group filter dropdown is as wide as its widest entry instead of the 110 px minimum
Faster site: instance/boss photos as WebP (10.5 MB -> 4 MB) plus 800 px copies for cards and thumbnails, smaller hero (two sizes), logo and wordmark as WebP, images cached for a week
Cache images and icons for a week (onSend hook; static's own maxAge won)
overlay chips show the damage taken in its own column right of the name, like the window, instead of under it
overlay mode keeps the player list's size - the chips sit where the list sits, full width, same row height and fonts, only the frame is dropped

uniform player rows - fixed columns (rank, class icon, name, damage taken, DPS, damage) with number columns shared across rows, the class-colour bar fills the whole row height, same layout in the chip overlay
Feedback form: centered, dropdown readable in both themes
Feedback form: themed type dropdown instead of the native select popup
Settings menu without the two disabled placeholder entries (Profile Settings, Key bindings)
Breadcrumb on run and participant pages now includes the instance, like the boss page
Run page breadcrumb ends with 'Run <id>'
Feedback form: website button + client window; reports become GitHub issues, optional recording encrypted (RSA/AES-GCM) into a private repo
Trust the nginx proxy for the client IP (per-visitor rate limit and IP hash)
feedback window (Settings menu) - report a problem or suggestion from the client as a GitHub issue, optionally with an encrypted capture recording
Leaderboard: whole podium card / row opens the run (stretched date link, player links stay clickable)
Start page: recent activity shows the boss picture (falls back to the instance photo)

a failed boss attempt is never uploaded - a fight goes online only when the boss's hit points reached 0 (the hotkey skips a boss that is still alive, and the automatic upload now fires on the HP-0 defeat, since Aion 2 sends no kill frame)
Start page: theme bootstrap moved from an inline script into theme-init.js (prepares a strict Content-Security-Policy)
the boss's hit points (from the game's HP frame) go along with every boss upload; the backend stores the highest reading per encounter (boss_max_hp) and returns it from the encounter API

expedition explore / conquest told apart correctly - NPC id block 231xxxx is explore, 230xxxx (and 232/233) conquest, checked on boss HP (the 230 block has 2-3x the HP); fights are re-filed by the boss that owns their NPC id
group leaderboard - class emblems are tinted in their class colour (duotone, keeps the shading); the top-3 player tiles get a soft class-coloured gradient and border
World boss areas get landscape pictures from the game client (Verteron, Altgard, Abyss)
World boss areas: Verteron, Altgard and Abyss pictures (wide format matching the tiles)
World bosses are their own area (/worldbosses, /worldbosses/<area>) instead of an instance category: overview, boss lists, breadcrumbs, sitemap; old /instances addresses redirect
Start page: the 'View data' button is called 'Instances'
Instances page: no World Bosses link among the tabs (the start page has the button)
Boss page: wide boss banners keep their own proportions in the hero (no zoom)
Start page: no download button in the hero (the footer has it)
Abyss world bosses Executor Argo and Executor Kaira are recognised and listed (with pictures); Draupnir's Afflicted Bakarma is merged into Transcendent Bakarma
Conquest instances are shown as 'Draupnir ★' (their star rating) instead of 'Draupnir (Conquest)' on the website, in page titles and in the link-preview picture
world bosses (Verteron, Altgard, Abyss; 52 bosses with their NPC ids) are recognised by the client and listed on the website as the new 'World Bosses' category, so fights can be uploaded

website - encounter link previews render a damage / healing / damage-taken picture (/og/encounters/<id>.png), instance backgrounds from the game client (un-squeezed, per-image focus), boss cards for expedition / transcendence / ascension bosses, Nightmare bosses lead back to Nightmare; world boss data (NPC ids, 8 client languages)
the own-fight restriction (only monsters the player fought) applies to the compact overlay's Group / Corps view only; everywhere else players fighting other monsters are listed too
the All / Group / Corps filter is back, but only for the compact transparent overlay; the normal window and the chip overlay list everybody again

the group / corps view filter is gone (everybody's damage is shown again); character window laid out like the website's player page (tabs, item and skill icons, Daevanion board tiles, species knowledge)
species knowledge (Cognia, Fera, Natura, Varia, Specia) read from the login frame and shown on the player profile
Nightmare places and bosses named in de/en/es/fr/ru from the EU client's text tables; instances renamed in place (English raw names, English slugs)

SEO: richer titles/descriptions per page (player profile with level/class/item level/guild/server/best run, boss with runs and stats per difficulty, instance with level/players/item level, encounter and participant previews, comparisons, search), preview images (boss/instance photos, class emblems), instance categories as real addresses (/instances/nightmare, /instances/expedition/hard), WebSite and ProfilePage JSON-LD
a team mate is no longer shown under one's own name (own-name fallback only while the local player is unknown)
Instances page: stars for Conquest, players and item level on the cards
Conquest instances in the game's own order (Krao, Draupnir, Urugugu, Vakron, Fire Temple, Grimmhorn)
Nightmare bosses: real NPC ids (ten per boss, one per level), English names, the level is read off the NPC id; client boss list regenerated
Timetable overlay: its own opacity setting in the Timetable page (30-100 %), falls back to the overlay opacity for old settings files
Nightmare boss ids (level read off the id), own timetable opacity
Player comparison: skill icons, localized names, own-class skills only

Group shields: damage_absorbed / shields_given columns, upload fields, API and UI (hatched shield section in the damage-taken panel, Protection cards for casters) - empty until the client reports them; panel renamed to 'Damage taken' in all languages
Instance photos for Shattered Arkanis, Deus Research Base and Sanctum of Loathing; wide banners of the seven Nightmare bosses (not wired up yet)
Expedition instance photos: clean boss crops from the full-screen shots (no window UI), 1600x880
Draupnir instance photo: the Draconute Task Captain

Instances page as category tabs (Expedition normal/hard, Nightmare boss tree, Ascension, Transcendence); only the 16 EU instances listed, the rest hidden; expedition hard mode is its own instance; per-boss difficulty steps (Nightmare level, Ascension difficulty, Transcendence stage) ranked separately via encounters.mode
game-data: conquest translations belong to the name table, not the image table
Settings window: cards (Display / Overlay / Behavior), switches instead of checkboxes, own pages for Hotkeys and Timetable, wider window; render-settings knows the new pages
settings window with cards, switches and own pages for hotkeys and timetable
Bar colours: class pairs share a hue family in a lighter and a deeper shade (Cleric/Chanter, Gladiator/Templar, Assassin/Ranger, Sorcerer/Spiritmaster); icons unchanged
meter row colours - class pairs share a hue family in a lighter and a deeper shade
Website: language follows the browser on first visit (stored choice wins, English fallback)
Participant page: new layout (hero, key figures, ranked skill rows) with skill icons resolved by name
Participant page: link to the player's profile (name and button)
URLs without the game segment (old /aion2/... links 301), player slugs (name-server) with 301 from numeric ids, profile icon after the name on the participant page
Pages: the game is a constant now that it is no longer in the address
Player profiles open for search engines: indexable, sitemap entries, richer server-rendered fragment, robots.txt fixed for the new paths
Participant skills: only the player's own class - effects fold into their skill, other classes' skills and 1-damage status markers are left out; icons from the own class's ids

Coloured class icons (ring + tint in the class colour) on the website and in the client, localized skill names on the participant page, subtle compare buttons incl. 'compare with another player' on the participant page, profiles without a fight indexable
Class colours shared by class pairs (Gladiator/Templar blue, Cleric/Chanter yellow, Assassin/Ranger green, Sorcerer/Spiritmaster purple), icons regenerated, Brawler icon added to the client
class icons in the class colours (ring + tint, shared per class pair), Brawler icon added
Aion 2 server ids - Asmodian early-access order fixed, Hithanya and Nemon added
class icons are the Aion 2 emblems on a dark plate with a gold ring
Item icons by the client's second naming scheme; Sword Aura Rampage icon (another class's art)
Item icons: three staves take the icon of the tier the client has (T06 instead of T05/T04)
Web: database timestamps without a zone are read as UTC (a fresh run looked two hours old in Germany)
Boss page: remove the "Boss mechanics" section
Leaderboard: top three groups as cards with class emblems, the rest as compact rows, sortable

Boss reset: a rise of 10% of max HP starts a new attempt even without a full-health frame; roles derived from the roster (Gladiator tank without Templar, Chanter DD with Cleric and damage over twice the healing)
Homepage: top players and recent runs as cards (class emblems, medal ranks, slim run cards with the dungeon photo)
the upload hotkey sends every boss fight not yet uploaded
character windows of other players survive a restart and go with boss uploads
Skill icons from the client's Skill table (the icon path in each skill's row) instead of a guess; equipped skills
the skill bar's equipped skills (with the break-free skill) are uploaded
Daevanion board: real common tile and class start tile from the game screenshots
skill list and stigmas are merged across the game's re-sends
Player details: DPS curve, hits and crit tiles, damage per target with the player's share; render-details mode
Player page: tabs (runs, equipment, skills, Daevanion boards) with the game's own item and skill icons
Player page: gear cards tinted by rarity, item tier shown, rarity colours as the game paints them
Player page: icon tiles take the rarity colour as background instead of the page blue
Daevanion boards from the client's node table with the game's node art; passive skill icons; skill frames like the game
Other players' character windows and own stigmas are read and uploaded; skill blocks side by side; board colours fixed
Aion 2: a spirit's basic attacks go to its owner when the meter started mid-fight
Aion 2: a boss healing itself by the hits it takes is no longer the player's damage
Aion 2: hits of target-debuff skills (Chain of Torment, Taunt) are damage
Auto reset is off by default (setting renamed to AutoResetEnabled, so the old saved 'on' is dropped)
Group scope without a roster falls back to the players fighting alongside; aion2-replay can list the party and the hit-point readings (AION2_PARTY=1)
Group scope keeps the roster's members after the group is left (the fight on screen is still theirs)
Scope switch All | Group | Corps in the compact overlay header and the Mode menu, replacing the 'only my party' setting; render-overlay and render-settings modes
Settings and secondary windows without AllowsTransparency (Win+Shift+S could not capture them); render-settings mode; shorter timetable label
Timetable overlay: what is active now and what starts within 60 minutes (Arena of Strategy first)
Timetable: any-time events, with the 1 vs 1 and 5 vs 5 arenas
Timetable: dated single occurrences, with the next Abyss raid (2026-10-03 21:00) read off the game's countdown
Settings: auto-reset checkbox aligned and its seconds field in the theme; the keep-on-top raise leaves Win+Shift+S alone
Aion 2: accented names; summons from before the meter started
Put the doc comments of SetSummonOwner and ClassFromCode back on their methods
Taken mode: a player's details show what hit them and how they died; a newer update replaces the downloaded one
Install and start without elevation errors: asInvoker + the meter raising itself
Aion 2 skill names in the UI language
Aion 2: name party members when the meter starts mid-dungeon; summon owner by caster id
Skill icons: damage events carry the skill id; 375 icons and their lookup
Skill breakdown: icons, sort by any column, crit note for Aion 2
Review: English skill names in the data, party first for a summon's owner
Review: classic Aion keeps its crit note; header tooltip and heal tiles localized
Hotkey for Upload Boss DMG and an opt-in auto upload after a boss died
Remove the remaining classic Aion leftovers from the client
Hide UI can look like the compact transparent panel (header, boss, dense class-coloured lines), chosen in Settings next to the chips; overlay opacity setting for both
Compact overlay: damage / healing / damage taken switch (badge, Mode menu, hotkey) and the boss health bar
Boss fight with its adds, auto reset, only-my-party filter, HP check status row, overlay kept in front of borderless full screen
Player list and overlay chips offer no UI Automation peers (the cause of the in-game crash)
Class 'Elementalist' is the Spiritmaster (de: Beschwoerer) everywhere; old name still accepted on upload
Do not end the meter on the WPF UI Automation NullReferenceException (ItemAutomationPeer.GetNameCore)
Overlay mode: the bars take three quarters of the window width
Client: coloured class bars behind each row (as long as the damage is of the top player), in the window and the overlay, like the website
Overlay mode: each player's bar spans the whole window width like in the normal view, damage and DPS on the right
Website: remove the loot area (encounter page, leaderboard badge, texts, styles); Aion 2 has no such loot rules
Website: person icon behind a player's name opens the character profile (when one exists)
Decoder: AION2_FRAMES dumps every decoded frame for protocol analysis
Settings: the five checkboxes of the interface page use the same spacing
Settings hotkeys: shorter field, no Assign button, click into the field opens an inline popup to press the combination
Overlay mode: Alt+Tab and the taskbar show a rendered picture of the overlay instead of an empty tile
Tray icon for as long as the meter runs, with a right-click menu: show window, show/hide UI, check for updates, exit
AionDPS design for every window: history window frame, own message box, dark tray menu
Secondary windows take the shared dark control styles (tooltip, combo box, check box, menu, button, scroll bar)
aion2-replay: list the server ids seen next to player names
Aion 2 server ids 1301-1308 and 2301-2308 with their names
Replace the chat commands with global hotkeys (overlay, pause, copy ranking, clear), configurable in Settings
Settings: hotkeys are assigned with an Assign button, then the next key combination is shown and stored
Server 1303 is Europe - Vaizel
Upload only the last attempt of a boss (boss HP reset marks a wipe and retry)

Download page: header download link blue too
aion2-replay: print each boss's hit-point check

Download page: gold main button again, header and footer buttons subdued to the theme surface
Download page: flat footer button

Aion 2: decoding fixes checked against the in-game combat analyzer (#1)
Homepage search covers both games (it was limited to the default game, so Aion 2 players were never found there)
Client: remove everything of classic Aion (Chat.log source and parser, loot, AP, relics, game detection, server catalog, characters, player database, classic data and icons)
Remove classic Aion from backend, website and docs; auto-upload switch for the own profile

Keep the running session across a client restart (update restart and App > Restart client)
Website data: Aion 2 only (classic names, instance and boss photos, class and skill icons removed); entry levels corrected from the game's own list
